svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 800 600" width="800" height="600" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <title>Pythagoras' Theorem Illustration</title>
  <style>
    .hypSquare {
      fill: #ffcc80;
      stroke: #b8860b;
      stroke-width: 2;
      animation: pulse 3s infinite;
    }
    @keyframes pulse {
      0% { fill-opacity: 0.6; }
      50% { fill-opacity: 1; }
      100% { fill-opacity: 0.6; }
    }
    .label {
      font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif;
      font-size: 24px;
      fill: #000;
    }
    .sideLabel {
      font-size: 20px;
      fill: #333;
    }
    .movingBox {
      fill: #4a90e2;
    }
  </style>

  <!-- Squares on the legs -->
  <!-- Square on side a (vertical) -->
  <rect x="350" y="170" width="180" height="180" fill="#add8e6" stroke="#4682b4" stroke-width="2"/>
  <text x="380" y="260" class="label">a²</text>

  <!-- Square on side b (horizontal) -->
  <rect x="110" y="350" width="240" height="240" fill="#ffb6c1" stroke="#c71585" stroke-width="2"/>
  <text x="180" y="470" class="label">b²</text>

  <!-- Square on the hypotenuse -->
  <polygon points="110,350 350,170 530,410 290,590" class="hypSquare"/>
  <text x="300" y="460" class="label">c²</text>

  <!-- Right‑angled triangle -->
  <line x1="110" y1="350" x2="350" y2="170" stroke="#000" stroke-width="4"/>
  <line x1="350" y1="170" x2="350" y2="350" stroke="#000" stroke-width="4"/>
  <line x1="350" y1="350" x2="110" y2="350" stroke="#000" stroke-width="4"/>

  <!-- Right‑angle marker -->
  <polyline points="340,340 350,340 350,330" fill="none" stroke="#000" stroke-width="2"/>

  <!-- Side labels -->
  <text x="360" y="260" class="sideLabel">a</text>
  <text x="220" y="380" class="sideLabel">b</text>
  <text x="240" y="260" class="sideLabel">c</text>

  <!-- Animated moving box illustrating addition -->
  <rect x="360" y="260" width="20" height="20" class="movingBox">
    <animate attributeName="x" values="360;400" dur="3s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
    <animate attributeName="y" values="260;460" dur="3s" repeatCount="indefinite" />
  </rect>
</svg>

subject: Biology
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 800 600" width="800" height="600" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <title>Photosynthesis Diagram</title>
  <style>
    .sun { animation: pulse 3s infinite; }
    @keyframes pulse {
      0%   { fill: #ffeb3b; }
      50%  { fill: #ff9800; }
      100% { fill: #ffeb3b; }
    }
    .flow { stroke-dasharray: 10 5; animation: dashmove 1.5s linear infinite; }
    @keyframes dashmove {
      from { stroke-dashoffset: 0; }
      to   { stroke-dashoffset: -15; }
    }
    text { font-family: sans-serif; fill: #333; }
  </style>

  <!-- Sun -->
  <circle class="sun" cx="100" cy="100" r="40" fill="#ffeb3b" />
  <text x="70" y="180" font-size="20">Sunlight</text>

  <!-- Leaf -->
  <ellipse cx="500" cy="300" rx="120" ry="80" fill="#7cfc00" stroke="#2e8b57" stroke-width="2"/>
  <text x="440" y="300" font-size="24" font-weight="bold">Glucose (C₆H₁₂O₆)</text>

  <!-- CO2 source -->
  <rect x="150" y="120" width="80" height="40" fill="#e0e0e0" stroke="#999" />
  <text x="160" y="145" font-size="18">CO₂</text>
  <!-- Arrow CO2 -->
  <line class="flow" x1="230" y1="140" x2="380" y2="250" stroke="#000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <polygon points="380,250 370,245 370,255" fill="#000"/>

  <!-- H2O source -->
  <ellipse cx="180" cy="470" rx="40" ry="25" fill="#add8e6" stroke="#4682b4"/>
  <text x="155" y="475" font-size="18">H₂O</text>
  <!-- Arrow H2O -->
  <line class="flow" x1="220" y1="470" x2="380" y2="350" stroke="#000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <polygon points="380,350 370,345 370,355" fill="#000"/>

  <!-- O2 output -->
  <line x1="620" y1="300" x2="750" y2="200" stroke="#000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <polygon points="750,200 740,195 740,205" fill="#000"/>
  <text x="660" y="180" font-size="18">O₂</text>
</svg>
